title: How do we draw the first steps of the triangle pattern?
description: The video draws the {{NAME_2}} Triangle at Step zero, Step one and Step two by joining midpoints and removing the middle triangle each time. It counts the triangles and holes at each step and checks the drawing against the counts.
teaching_notes: One idea: at every step, each remaining triangle is cut the same way as the first one. Watch for students who forget that the hole from an earlier step stays in the picture.

video_script.why: The child draws each step by cutting every remaining triangle the way the first one was cut.
video_script.substitution: Join the midpoints of every remaining triangle, remove its middle triangle, and count the triangles and the holes.
video_script.anchor: the {{NAME_2}} Triangle of the book, drawn at Step zero, Step one and Step two in three frames
video_script.payoff_line: Step one has three triangles around one hole, and Step two has nine triangles and four holes

final_answer.value: Step 0 is one triangle, Step 1 shows 3 triangles around 1 hole, Step 2 shows 9 triangles and 4 holes
final_answer.spoken: Step zero is one triangle. Step one has three triangles around one hole, and Step two has nine triangles and four holes

names.{{NAME_2}}: Polish mathematician who discovered the carpet and the triangle

hold_back: Answer: Step 0 is one triangle, Step 1 shows 3 triangles around 1 hole, Step 2 shows 9 triangles and 4 holes
never_show: a Step 2 drawing with fewer than four holes
maths_rules: Step 1: join midpoints, remove the middle triangle; 3 triangles, 1 hole
Step 2: cut each of the 3 triangles; 3 x 3 = 9 triangles; new holes 3; total holes 1 + 3 = 4
check: 9 triangles and 4 holes at Step 2
video_script.design: Three frames in a row on the stage. Each frame is drawn in turn, and the counts are written under it.

beats.on_screen: a small title card From your book; the {{NAME_2}} Triangle name; three empty frames labelled Step 0, Step 1 and Step 2

marks.book: the title card and the name appear

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book about the {{NAME_2}} Triangle.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>We draw the first steps of the pattern, at least up to Step two. How many triangles and holes does Step two show?

beats.on_screen: the three frames stay on the board with an accent underline

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

beats.on_screen: one triangle with its midpoints joined; the middle triangle is shaded out and the other three stay

marks.same: the triangle of the example is shown again with its midpoints joined
marks.hole: the middle triangle fades and leaves a gap

narration: <bookmark mark='same'/>We cut a triangle the same way as the example in your book.
<bookmark mark='hole'/>Join the midpoints of its sides and remove the middle triangle. The gap is a hole.
<bookmark mark='keep'/>The three corner triangles stay, and each is a smaller copy of the first.

beats.on_screen: Given: Step 0 is one equilateral triangle. Each step cuts every triangle by joining its midpoints and removes the middle one.

marks.given: the starting triangle and the rule are written

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, Step zero is one equilateral triangle. Each step joins the midpoints of every triangle and removes the middle one.

beats.on_screen: To draw: Step 0, Step 1 and Step 2, with their triangles and holes

marks.find: the words Step 0, Step 1 and Step 2 are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to draw Step zero, Step one and Step two. Count the triangles and holes in each.

beats.on_screen: Step 0: one equilateral triangle, no hole

marks.draw: one equilateral triangle is drawn in the first frame and shaded

narration: <bookmark mark='draw'/>Step one, draw Step zero. It is a single equilateral triangle, shaded, and it has no hole.

beats.on_screen: Step 1: join the midpoints and remove the middle triangle. 3 triangles, 1 hole

marks.join: the midpoints are joined in the second frame
marks.cut: the middle triangle fades and the line 3 triangles, 1 hole is written

narration: <bookmark mark='join'/>Step two, draw Step one by joining the midpoints of the three sides.
<bookmark mark='cut'/>Remove the middle triangle, and three triangles stay around one hole.

beats.on_screen: Step 2: cut each of the 3 triangles. 3 x 3 = 9 triangles. New holes 3, old hole 1, so 1 + 3 = 4 holes

marks.cut: each of the three triangles is cut in the third frame and loses its middle
marks.hole: the old hole glows and 1 + 3 = 4 holes is written

narration: <bookmark mark='cut'/>Step three, draw Step two. Cut each of the three triangles the same way.
<bookmark mark='tri'/>Each gives three triangles, and three times three is nine.
<bookmark mark='hole'/>Each cut makes a new hole, so three new holes join the old one. One plus three is four.

beats.on_screen: Check: count the drawing. Step 1 has 3 triangles and 1 hole. Step 2 has 9 triangles and 4 holes.

marks.count: the shaded triangles of the third frame are counted one by one
marks.holes: the holes of the third frame are counted one by one

narration: <bookmark mark='count'/>Step four, check the drawing. Count the shaded triangles in the last frame, one by one.
<bookmark mark='holes'/>There are nine. Then count the holes, the big one and the three small ones, which makes four.

beats.on_screen: Answer: Step 0 is one triangle, Step 1 shows 3 triangles around 1 hole, Step 2 shows 9 triangles and 4 holes
narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>Step zero is one triangle. Step one has three triangles around one hole, and Step two has nine triangles and four holes.
